gates.name: source health
gates.condition: Unresolved non-reconciliation source, partition or consumer failures produce an unhealthy source result.

gates.name: source capacity unresolved failure
gates.condition: An unresolved SOURCE-scoped non-capacity failure blocks historical work.

gates.name: source capacity volume identity
gates.condition: The volume path must be absolute; its mounted UUID and supported local disk must match the ClickHouse server.

gates.name: source capacity measured capacity
gates.condition: A range backfill requires a successful representative working-set measurement.

gates.name: source capacity byte reserve
gates.condition: Free bytes must cover max(ceil(total * reserve_tenths / 10), measured * working_set_factor * concurrency).

gates.name: source capacity inode reserve
gates.condition: Total inode count must be positive and free inodes times denominator must cover total inodes.

gates.name: source reader coverage canonical mask
gates.condition: Canonical days replace overlapping provisional minutes.

gates.name: source reader coverage first gap
gates.condition: Provisional partitions after the first missing interval are excluded from current readers.

gates.name: provider archive availability
gates.condition: Latest-day archive absence waits; an older missing archive fails.

gates.name: provider response completeness archive checksum
gates.condition: Archive bytes must match the official SHA-256 sidecar.

gates.name: provider response completeness archive member
gates.condition: The ZIP must contain exactly the expected dated CSV member.

gates.name: provider response completeness archive rows
gates.condition: The archive must be nonempty, have its declared field count, unique increasing IDs, ordered timestamps and rows inside its UTC day.

gates.name: sensor retry terminal state
gates.condition: An existing nonterminal or successful run suppresses another attempt; after run retirement the durable receipt must be failed or canceled before retry.

gates.name: sensor retry budget
gates.condition: Retry is withheld after the configured retry count.

gates.name: sensor retry backoff
gates.condition: Retry waits until retry_delay seconds after the last terminal attempt.

gates.name: sensor reconciliation active run
gates.condition: An active health run prevents another health run.

gates.name: sensor reconciliation native run
gates.condition: An active reconciliation batch, native source backfill or run for the selected partition defers canonical reconciliation.

gates.name: sensor reconciliation backoff
gates.condition: An unchanged failed or canceled reconciliation without a terminal failure verdict waits for the delay indexed by its capped attempt.

gates.name: sensor reconciliation terminal verdict
gates.condition: An unchanged authority with a terminal automatic failure verdict waits for operator retry or a state change; removed parity verdicts are excluded.

gates.name: sensor reconciliation batch
gates.condition: Reconciliation rotates only changed or urgent partitions up to the batch limit; missing-component upgrades fill only slots repairs leave.

gates.name: sensor reconciliation cadence
gates.condition: Health runs wait for minimum interval; at idle interval they run even without new failures.

gates.name: orchestration admission source pool
gates.condition: Concurrent source canonical operations cannot exceed their pool limit.

gates.name: source rollout public
gates.condition: Public consumers require LIVE rollout.

gates.name: publication ownership
gates.condition: An active backfill or publication run defers competing worker publication.

gates.name: worker minute admission closed

gates.name: worker minute admission covered
gates.condition: Already covered minutes are excluded.

gates.name: worker minute admission catchup
gates.condition: Admit latest minute and missing lookback minutes up to the catch-up cap; frontier repair can precede this window.

gates.name: worker minute admission retry
gates.condition: Failed minute attempts wait exponential backoff capped by source retry delay.

gates.name: worker minute admission concurrent
gates.condition: Minute work cannot exceed the worker thread limit.

gates.name: provider response completeness page cap

gates.condition: Every row must satisfy the adapter field and value contract.

gates.name: provider response completeness empty minute
gates.condition: An empty minute requires locator observations on two different clock minutes for that partition and a later trade proving the end boundary.

gates.name: orchestration admission duplicate
gates.condition: Equivalent outstanding request identities suppress duplicate runs.
gates.evidence_source: Dagster request identity/redundant tags and runs

gates.name: orchestration runtime start timeout seconds
gates.condition: Run monitoring enforces configured start_timeout_seconds; an explicit per-run runtime overrides its default.

gates.name: orchestration runtime cancel timeout seconds
gates.condition: Run monitoring enforces configured cancel_timeout_seconds; an explicit per-run runtime overrides its default.

gates.name: orchestration runtime max runtime seconds
gates.condition: Run monitoring enforces configured max_runtime_seconds; an explicit per-run runtime overrides its default.

gates.name: orchestration runtime job default
gates.condition: Short non-bulk jobs use the short default; other runs use the general default; an explicit nonzero tag is preserved.

gates.name: orchestration admission redundant launch
gates.condition: A run whose redundancy tag names that run is canceled before worker launch.
gates.evidence_source: Dagster run tags and cancellation events

gates.name: orchestration runtime launch health
gates.condition: The worker must remain reachable and report the launched run as active.
